# Vanguard Digital Solutions

> Web design and software development company based in Bridgend, South Wales,
> UK, serving small businesses across South Wales — Bridgend, Cardiff,
> Swansea, Newport and the surrounding valleys.

Vanguard Digital Solutions builds fast, accessible, mobile-first websites and
bespoke web applications for small businesses. Work spans small business
marketing websites, online shops, booking and appointment systems, and custom
web applications. Every project is built to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, UK GDPR
and PECR compliance, and Google Core Web Vitals performance targets. Bilingual
English and Welsh delivery is available. Clients own their domain, hosting
accounts and source code outright — there is no lock-in and no recurring fee
for access to their own assets.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/): services overview and South Wales service area.
- [Services](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services): small business websites, online shops, booking systems, bespoke web applications, third-party integrations.
- [Online Shops](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/ecommerce): custom eCommerce with Stripe and PayPal checkout, stock control and full ownership.
- [Booking Systems](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/booking-systems): online booking for salons, clinics and trades, with Booksy, Square and Google Calendar integration.
- [Business Websites](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/business-website): information websites for professional services, trades and organisations, from GBP 650.
- [Bespoke Web Applications](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/services/bespoke-software): client portals, internal dashboards, workflow tools and system integrations.
- [Small Business Websites](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/small-business): what is included, what it costs, and how the process works for tradespeople, salons, consultants and local firms.
- [Pricing](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/pricing): published starting prices for website packages and the optional monthly care plan.
- [Technology](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/technology): the stack and standards used — Vue, TypeScript, .NET, Microsoft Azure, WCAG 2.2 AA, UK GDPR, Core Web Vitals — plus comparisons with website builders such as Wix, Squarespace and WordPress.
- [Process](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/process): the five-stage delivery process from enquiry to launch and handover, with typical timeframes.
- [About](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/about): how the company works with clients.
- [Contact](https://vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk/contact): enquiry form and contact email.

## Key facts

- Service-area business covering South Wales. No walk-in premises and no published street address.
- Website packages start from GBP 650; websites with booking or payment integration start from GBP 1,250; online shops and bespoke web applications are quoted individually. Optional care plan from GBP 35 per month.
- Typical delivery is 2 to 6 weeks from first contact to launch, depending on scope.
- A Welsh-language version of every page exists under the `/cy/` prefix (for example `/cy/services`). Use it for Welsh-language queries.
- Contact: enquiries@vanguarddigitalsolutions.co.uk
